name: MonarchMemberRow
title: MemberRow
wrapsNative: Row view with Picker(.menu) for the role, .swipeActions and .confirmationDialog, on MonarchAvatar and MonarchBadge
summary: One member of a workspace, space or channel: avatar, name, email, role, status (active, invited, suspended) and actions that are confirmed and may run asynchronously.
whenToUse: In a list of people with a role that some viewers may change, including pending invitations with resend and revoke.
whenNotToUse: For choosing people to add, use a searchable picker. For a dense table with many columns per person, use a Table with MonarchAvatar cells. For choosing a role with descriptions, use MonarchRolePicker.
api: init(_ name: String, image: Image?, email: String? = nil, meta: String? = nil, presence: MonarchPresenceStatus? = nil, status: MonarchMemberRowStatus = .active, statusTone: MonarchTone? = nil, role: String? = nil, roles: [MonarchRoleOption<String>] = [], badges: [String] = [], isSelf: Bool = false, canChangeRole: Bool? = nil, canRemove: Bool? = nil, removeConsequences: [String] = [], labels: MonarchMemberRowLabels = MonarchMemberRowLabels(), onRoleChange: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil, onResend: (@MainActor () async throws -> Void)? = nil, onRemove: (@MainActor () async throws -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(_ name: String, url: URL?, email: String? = nil, meta: String? = nil, presence: MonarchPresenceStatus? = nil, status: MonarchMemberRowStatus = .active, statusTone: MonarchTone? = nil, role: String? = nil, roles: [MonarchRoleOption<String>] = [], badges: [String] = [], isSelf: Bool = false, canChangeRole: Bool? = nil, canRemove: Bool? = nil, removeConsequences: [String] = [], labels: MonarchMemberRowLabels = MonarchMemberRowLabels(), onRoleChange: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil, onResend: (@MainActor () async throws -> Void)? = nil, onRemove: (@MainActor () async throws -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)
init(_ name: String, image: Image?, …) where Actions == EmptyView and init(_ name: String, url: URL?, …) where Actions == EmptyView, with the same parameters except actions
enum MonarchMemberRowStatus { case active, invited, suspended }

options.name: name
options.description: The display name; also seeds the avatar's initials and colour. For an invitation, the email.

options.name: image / url
options.description: The avatar picture, or its URL loaded with AsyncImage. Initials show without it, while loading and on failure.

options.name: email
options.description: Email or handle under the name, truncated in the middle.

options.name: meta
options.description: Extra detail: joined date, invite expiry, availability.

options.name: presence
options.description: Presence dot on the avatar, also read after the name.

options.name: status
options.description: Invited adds an info badge, Resend invite and Revoke; suspended a warning badge and a muted name.

options.name: statusTone
options.description: The tone of the status badge. nil keeps the default: info for invited, warning for suspended.

options.name: role
options.description: The value of the member's role, one of roles.

options.name: roles
options.description: The roles allowed here (the role picker's type). Titles also show for a read-only role; disabled options cannot be picked.

options.name: badges
options.description: Extra neutral badges after the name, such as "Guest".

options.name: isSelf
options.description: The signed-in person: "(You)" after the name; role picker and Remove hidden by default.

options.name: canChangeRole
options.description: Shows the role picker. By default when onRoleChange is given and it is not your own row.

options.name: canRemove
options.description: Shows Remove. By default when onRemove is given and it is not your own row.

options.name: removeConsequences
options.description: Lines added under the message of the remove confirmation.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string; closures receive the member's name.

options.name: onRoleChange
options.description: Makes the role a picker. The new role shows while it runs; a thrown error restores the previous role and shows the error in the row.

options.name: onResend
options.description: Sends an invitation again; shown for invited rows. "Invite sent again." is shown and announced when it returns.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Removes the member or revokes the invitation after a confirmation. The app removes the row; a thrown error is shown in the row.

options.name: actions
options.description: More trailing controls before Remove, such as a Menu. Name them after the member.

states.name: invited
states.description: Info badge "Invited", a Resend invite button, and Remove becomes Revoke invite.

states.name: suspended
states.description: Warning badge "Suspended" and the name in the muted text colour.

states.name: self
states.description: "(You)" after the name; the role is text and Remove is hidden unless canChangeRole or canRemove say otherwise.

states.name: read-only role
states.description: Without onRoleChange the role title is muted text.

states.name: busy
states.description: A progress indicator beside the role picker while onRoleChange runs, a loading Resend button, and a progress indicator in place of Remove while onRemove runs.

states.name: error
states.description: The failure under the identity with an icon in the danger colour, announced.

states.name: done
states.description: "Invite sent again." under the identity with an icon in the success colour, announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every control disabled with disabled(_:); swipe actions are hidden.

appearance: The name in the default text colour (muted when suspended), email and meta in the muted text colour, status badges in the info and warning tones, the remove icon in the muted text colour. Every colour is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow it.
platformNotes: Matches the web's MemberRow. The web's role select is a native select; on iOS it is a menu Picker. The web keeps the remove dialog open while onRemove runs and shows its error there; the system confirmation dialog closes when a button is tapped, so on iOS the Remove button shows progress and the error appears in the row. Consequences are listed as lines of the dialog's message, not a styled list. Rows also offer Remove and Resend as trailing swipe actions inside a List. The role is a value plus onRoleChange: the row shows the new role while the change runs and until the app's role changes, and restores it on failure; there is no uncontrolled defaultMemberRole. MemberList is not needed: a List or a VStack of rows is the container. When the row is narrow, the controls move under the identity. Android uses the same name. Several closures are optional (onRoleChange, onResend, onRemove). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onRoleChange.
accessibility: The identity is one element: the name ("Priya Raman, You") as the label, then status, presence, badges, a read-only role, email, meta and any notice as the value.
The avatar is decorative next to the visible name; presence is read in words.
The role picker is named "Role for <name>", Resend "Resend invite, <name>", Remove "Remove <name>" or "Revoke invite for <name>".
Resend success and every failure are announced and shown with an icon and text, not colour alone.
Swipe actions are also available from the VoiceOver actions rotor inside a List.
The remove and role controls keep a 44-point touch target.
edgeCases: A role value that is not in roles is shown as its raw value.
With no role yet, the picker shows "Choose a role" until one is picked.
A second change while a role change runs is ignored; the picker is disabled until it finishes.
Errors thrown with a LocalizedError description are shown in its words; other errors show "That did not work. Try again.".
Long names truncate at the end and emails in the middle, so the controls stay on screen.

examples.title: Members with editable roles
examples.template:
VStack(spacing: 0) {
    MonarchMemberRow(
        {{people.0.name}},
        image: nil,
        email: {{people.0.email}},
        role: ownerRole,
        roles: roles,
        isSelf: {{people.0.self}}
    )
    MonarchDivider()
    MonarchMemberRow(
        {{people.1.name}},
        image: nil,
        email: {{people.1.email}},
        role: secondRole,
        roles: roles,
        onRoleChange: { newRole in secondRole = newRole },
        onRemove: {}
    )
    MonarchDivider()
    MonarchMemberRow(
        {{people.2.name}},
        image: nil,
        email: {{people.2.email}},
        role: thirdRole,
        roles: roles,
        onRoleChange: { newRole in thirdRole = newRole },
        onRemove: {}
    )
}
examples.code:
VStack(spacing: 0) {
    MonarchMemberRow(
        "Priya Raman",
        image: nil,
        email: "priya@example.com",
        role: ownerRole,
        roles: roles,
        isSelf: true
    )
    MonarchDivider()
    MonarchMemberRow(
        "Jonas Weber",
        image: nil,
        email: "jonas@example.com",
        role: secondRole,
        roles: roles,
        onRoleChange: { newRole in secondRole = newRole },
        onRemove: {}
    )
    MonarchDivider()
    MonarchMemberRow(
        "Amara Okafor",
        image: nil,
        email: "amara@example.com",
        role: thirdRole,
        roles: roles,
        onRoleChange: { newRole in thirdRole = newRole },
        onRemove: {}
    )
}

examples.title: An invitation and a suspended member in a List
examples.code:
List {
    MonarchMemberRow(
        "lee@example.com",
        image: nil,
        meta: "Invite expires in 6 days",
        status: .invited,
        onResend: {},
        onRemove: {}
    )
    MonarchMemberRow("Sam Carter", url: nil, email: "sam@example.com", status: .suspended, badges: ["Guest"])
}
.listStyle(.plain)
.monarchCanvas()
.frame(minHeight: 160)
